title: The Potter and the Clay
description: The Lord sends Jeremiah down to the house of the potter, where he sees the potter shaping a broken clay vessel on the wheel. God uses this as an illustration of how He deals with the house of Israel: If a nation turns from its evil, He relents of the disaster He planned; but if it does what is evil, He relents of the good He had promised. [ref:Jer 18:1-10|Jeremiah 18:1-10]
